audited_plan.image_description: A large, complex radio telescope structure situated in a grassy field under an overcast sky. The main feature is a massive parabolic dish antenna with a distinctive open-lattice steel backing structure (truss work) rather than a solid back. To the left, there is a tall support tower connected to the dish via suspension cables, suggesting a steerable or alt-azimuth mount design. In the foreground, there is a dirt path, green vegetation, and small white utility buildings.
